usedFor: CallRail records calls and texts, HubSpot holds contacts and deals, and “Call Modified” can drive “Update Contact” in HubSpot.

bestTemplate.name: “Outbound Call Ends” in CallRail, then “Update Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Once an outbound call ends, the action changes chosen properties on an existing deal.

watchOut: “Update Deal” needs the deal ID, so the CallRail event must carry it.
